title: Ordinary Hom complexes commute with scheme open restriction
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open subscheme, and L,M arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complexes of O_Y-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. Write res_U for Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι, applied degreewise. There is an isomorphism of cochain complexes res_U(Hom^bullet_Y(L,M)) ≅ Hom^bullet_U(res_U L,res_U M), with Hom^bullet the ordinary sheaf Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex]. No boundedness, freeness, K-injectivity or derived-category hypothesis is assumed.

from.place: Local Koszul derived sheaf Hom computation: transport the ordinary Hom complex from the over-open site to the open subscheme

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_restrict_scheme {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.Opens)
    (L M : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) :
    Nonempty (
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (homComplex (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf) L M) ≅
      homComplex (R := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M))
